info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Hotel Loyalty Points Balances-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Loyalty Points Balance API provides access to the current loyalty points balances for members. Consumers can retrieve detailed information on a member's accumulated loyalty points across various hotel brands. This endpoint is typically used by mobile applications, customer service platforms, or loyalty management systems looking to enhance user engagement and customer service. By integrating this API, businesses can offer real-time insights to customers about their points, driving loyalty and satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve their current points balance. It provides a snapshot of the total points accrued, which can be used for rewards and other benefits.

requestBody.description: Request body containing the parameters necessary to retrieve the points balance for a user. Ensure that the request is properly formatted as per the specified schema.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the current points balance.
